title: NES / Famicom
architecture: Ricoh 2A03/6502-like CPU; PPU scanline and dot timing; mapper/MMC bus behavior; APU channels.
diagnostic_probes: Verify PPU-visible fetch timing, mapper IRQ edges, open-bus and DMA cycle parity.

title: SNES / Super Famicom
architecture: 65C816 main CPU, PPU dual-screen/window/mode7 behavior, SPC700/S-DSP audio and enhancement coprocessors.
diagnostic_probes: Trace DMA/HDMA, bus access arbitration, IRQ/NMI cycle edges, DSP sample timing.

title: Game Boy / Game Boy Color
architecture: SM83 CPU, PPU modes, OAM/VRAM access rules, MBC cartridges, timer edge cases.
diagnostic_probes: Differential-test HALT/STOP, timer glitches, sprite priority, mode transitions.

title: Game Boy Advance
architecture: ARM7TDMI ARM/Thumb, BIOS SWI, affine/tiled graphics, timers, DMA channels, interrupts.
diagnostic_probes: Validate pipeline-prefetch, WAITCNT, DMA scheduling, OAM/VRAM palette and affine math.

title: Nintendo 64
architecture: MIPS R4300i CPU, RSP vector coprocessor and microcode, RDP display lists, VI/AI/PI/SI devices.
diagnostic_probes: Capture task microcode variant, RSP/RDP command trace, cache/RDRAM coherence and VI output.

title: GameCube / Wii
architecture: PowerPC Gekko/Broadway, GX TEV rasterization, DSP/ARAM, IOS IPC and memory-mapped peripherals.
diagnostic_probes: Compare PowerPC paired-single/JIT execution, EFB copy, TEV stages, IOS response timing.

title: Wii U
architecture: PowerPC Espresso multicore, Cafe OS, GX2 graphics, Latte tiling, MEM1/MEM2 virtual memory.
diagnostic_probes: Trace GX2 resource tiling, command queues, shader translation, Cafe syscall ownership.

title: Nintendo Switch
architecture: ARMv8-A guest code, Horizon-style HLE kernel and services, Maxwell GPU, NVN shader/texture formats.
diagnostic_probes: Inspect guest PC and service IPC first; then texture mappings, GPU barriers, fences, shader translation and presentation.

title: Switch 2 research
architecture: Treat publicly available architecture descriptions as incomplete and version-specific. Preserve generation-specific runtime behavior. Do not infer proprietary GPU commands from names alone.
diagnostic_probes: For black output distinguish guest draws, command submission, image writes, image/layout transitions, waits/fences, swapchain and genuinely recognizable pixels. Match game Build ID and native core revision.

title: Nintendo DS / DSi
architecture: ARM9 + ARM7 processors, IPC FIFO, dual 2D engines, geometry/3D rasterization, DMA and cartridge IO.
diagnostic_probes: Check inter-CPU timing, scanline transitions, geometry FIFO, depth/alpha precision, shared memory sync.

title: Nintendo 3DS
architecture: ARM11 and ARM9, 3DS kernel/services, PICA200 GPU shader units, CTR container formats.
diagnostic_probes: Inspect service IPC descriptors, GPU command buffer and vertex shader features, display ownership.

title: PlayStation / PS1
architecture: MIPS R3000A, GTE fixed-point transform, primitive GPU renderer, SPU ADPCM and CD-ROM timing.
diagnostic_probes: Differential-test GTE saturation flags, GPU packet decoding, DMA arbitration, CD IRQ timing.

title: PlayStation 2
architecture: Emotion Engine MIPS, VU0/VU1 vector microcode, GIF/VIF DMA, GS pixel semantics and IOP interaction.
diagnostic_probes: Capture VIF/VU program state, GS register writes, texture cache invalidation and EE/IOP timing.

title: PlayStation 3
architecture: Cell PPU+SPU, SPU local-store DMA, LV2 HLE syscalls, RSX FIFO/tiling and synchronization.
diagnostic_probes: Separate PPU/SPU faults, RSX resource state, SPU DMA stalls, syscall args and host device loss.

title: PlayStation 4
architecture: x86-64 guest, AMD GCN command processors/shaders, GNM APIs, memory maps, library/HLE compatibility.
diagnostic_probes: Capture guest syscalls, GPU PM4 stream, descriptor/texture metadata, synchronization and compiler lowering.

title: PSP
architecture: Allegrex MIPS CPU, VFPU, GE command lists, HLE modules, media engine and SPU-like audio pipeline.
diagnostic_probes: Check VFPU math flags, GE command ordering, HLE module ABI, JIT block invalidation.

title: PS Vita
architecture: ARM Cortex-A9, user/kernel services, SceGxm graphics interfaces and shader translation.
diagnostic_probes: Check import table/NID binding, GXM resource formats, shader uniform layouts and synchronization.

title: Original Xbox
architecture: x86 Pentium III-like CPU, Xbox kernel API, NV2A GPU, MCPX audio/DSP and memory mapped peripherals.
diagnostic_probes: Trace GPU pushbuffer commands, vertex formats, kernel object lifetimes and audio DSP behavior.

title: Xbox 360
architecture: PowerPC Xenon, Xenos GPU unified shaders, eDRAM, tiled textures and Xbox 360 kernel APIs.
diagnostic_probes: Validate PPC endian behavior, eDRAM resolves, texture tiling, GPU packet parsing and guest allocations.

title: Mega Drive / Genesis
architecture: Motorola 68000 + Z80 sound, VDP planes/sprites/DMA, YM2612 FM and PSG.
diagnostic_probes: Compare VDP FIFO stalls, H/V counter/IRQ edges and YM2612 timing.

title: Sega Saturn
architecture: Dual SH-2 CPUs, SCU DMA/DSP, VDP1 distorted quads and VDP2 backgrounds; precise bus arbitration.
diagnostic_probes: Capture inter-CPU ordering, SCU DMA timing, VDP1 command list and VDP2 blending.

title: Dreamcast / NAOMI
architecture: Hitachi SH-4, PowerVR2 tile-based deferred rendering, AICA ARM7 audio and Maple peripherals.
diagnostic_probes: Trace tile bins, translucent pass sorting, twiddled textures and SH4 DMA/cache coherency.

title: Arcade systems
architecture: Hardware differs per board; define machine/device/bus map, clocks, video/audio and cartridge security for the specific board.
diagnostic_probes: Check actual board revision, ROM region layout and device configuration; use per-device tests rather than assuming generic arcade hardware.

title: DOS-era PC
architecture: x86 real/protected modes, BIOS/DOS services, VGA planar memory, PIT/PIC, DMA, OPL audio and timing.
diagnostic_probes: Compare interrupt behavior, timer divisors, VRAM latches, DMA channels and sample timing.

title: Other or emerging platforms
architecture: Begin with a documented CPU ISA, memory map, timing graph, executable format, OS API and device interfaces. Unknown hardware behavior must remain hypotheses.
diagnostic_probes: Build a homebrew instruction/service smoke test and a small known-answer device test before commercial titles.
